text.en: Each child gets a card: a source, a type of energy or a use. They walk around to find the two others who complete their chain.

Energy flow game: cards show sources such as Sun or wind, types such as heat, light and movement, and uses such as drying clothes or turning a turbine. Sun, heat, dries clothes. Wind, movement, turns a turbine.
Energy makes our world active and alive. We get clean energy from the Sun, wind and water, which does not pollute the Earth. Let us use and save it wisely and choose clean sources.
Energy efficiency means using less energy to do the same work. An LED bulb gives the same light as older bulbs but uses less electricity.
Traditional Indian houses with small windows and thick walls stayed cool in summer and warm in winter. Vaastu Shastra planned rooms, doors and windows to use sunlight and wind well, and courtyards keep homes bright and airy.
Our body stores energy for later, so we can still walk after skipping a meal. Batteries store energy too.
Reflect: what will happen without electricity for a day, why solar and wind are better than coal, and what one thing you can do at home to save energy.
Make a plan of a clean energy home with solar or wind energy, and keep an energy diary for one day.
(additional, not in the textbook) Switch off lights and fans when you leave a room.

problem.en: Why is an LED bulb better?

text.en: It gives the same light.
It uses less electricity.
So it saves energy and money.

prompt.en: How can we save energy at home?

commonMisconceptions.en: Thinking one small act does not matter

points.en: Energy efficiency means using less for the same work.
Choose clean sources and save energy.
